newsitem.title: GERMANY: Bayer says has accident at German plant.
newsitem.headline: Bayer says has accident at German plant.

text.p: Bayer AG said on Wednesday that several tonnes of a cancer-causing chemical used to make foam products escaped from one of its German plants late on Monday but that no one was injured in the accident.
The chemical involved in the accident, Toluylendiamin, has been shown to cause cancer in laboratory animals and is poisonous upon direct contact, Bayer said.

Bayer said the majority of the spilled chemical stayed within the plant's property but that a nearby street was closed and a train passing by the plant at the time of the accident was inspected for contamination.
The cause of the accident is under investigation and no estimates of damage to the plant were immediately available.
